title: The Vaal Civilization
subtitle: ~900 – 400 BIC — From dazzling glory to catastrophic collapse

cards.title: Origins — From Xibaqua
cards.text: Vaal legend says: "From the flesh of the gods, Xibaqua was born. From the bones of Xibaqua, we were born." Xibaqua betrayed the gods — was punished. The gods reclaimed their flesh, leaving only a single drop of pure light — the first Vaal.
cards.flavorText: "Both reverence and ambition flow through the Vaal bloodline." — Story of the Vaal

cards.title: Virtue Gems — Tears of Maji
cards.text: The Azmeri called Virtue Gems "Tears of Maji." The Vaal discovered how to activate them through blood sacrifice. When the Karui touched them, they suffered Blood Fever — a violent frenzy. This is why the Karui Way forbids the use of gems.
cards.flavorText: "The tears of gods fell, and we picked them up and called it power." — Doryani

cards.title: Queen Atziri & Doryani
cards.text: Atziri — the last Queen, obsessed with eternal beauty. Doryani — genius thaumaturgist who built the Temple of Atzoatl and developed Soul Cores. Kishara possessed a fallen star containing enormous energy. Doryani pursued immortality alongside Zerphi.
cards.flavorText: "Beauty is the only power that needs no justification." — Queen Atziri

cards.title: The Red Communion — The Fall (~400 BIC)
cards.text: Doryani performed the Red Communion — an immortality ritual for Atziri using soul cores and immense energy. The power spiraled out of control — tearing reality apart. Civilization was erased. Atziri was sealed in another dimension. Doryani was cast into the depths of Delve.
cards.warning: Atziri did not die — she was sealed away, summonable via Vaal Fragments.
cards.flavorText: "The greatest ambition always brings the greatest destruction." — Eramir

cards.title: Legacy After the Fall
cards.text: After the catastrophe: Utzaal was seized by Cenobites and Anchorites. Barbaric tribes rose: Oroks (Azakh-Kul) — ruin builders, Azaks (Carvers) — artisan sculptors. The Kalguur began colonizing Wraeclast immediately after.
cards.flavorText: "Through war we find peace. Through death we find progress." — Story of the Vaal
